name: CVVF Video Content Taxonomy
description: Taxonomy for classifying Chinese viral videos into production-ready categories

ai_movie.description: Videos created with AI visual generation, AI sci-fi concepts, or AI trailers

short_film.description: Short cinematic films, indie micro-movies, emotional or narrative short stories

drama_series.name_vi: Phim bộ / Trích đoạn kịch tính
drama_series.description: Episodic dramas, mini-dramas, cliffhanger serial clips

comedy.description: Comedy sketches, pranks, jokes, parodies, humorous daily situations

daily_life.description: Daily vlogs, street food, cooking, crafts, travel, pets, rural life

knowledge.description: Educational content, science explainers, tech reviews, handmade DIY inventions

animation.description: 2D/3D animations, anime clips, motion comics, CGI shorts

other.description: Fallback category when metadata does not match specific topics
